required_behavior: On read failure retain typed unavailability/cancellation and original approved retry budget; never infer changed chain evidence from a failed read.
Only after successful read compare returned evidence; actual malformed or contradictory authority is an integrity refusal.
Keep affected signing/action pending with original bytes and custody; healthy independent work may continue.
